verses.original: רַנְּנ֣וּ בַּֽיהוָ֑ה צַ֭דִּיקִים נָאוָ֥ה לַ֝יְשָׁרִ֗ים תְהִלָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ran·nə·nū Yah·weh ṣad·dî·qîm nā·wāh lay·šā·rîm ṯə·hil·lāh
verses.literal: Rejoice in the LORD O righteous ones it is fitting for the upright to praise [Him]

verses.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר זַמְּרוּ־ לֽוֹ׃ עָ֝שׂ֗וֹר בְּנֵ֥בֶל
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏū Yah·weh bə·ḵin·nō·wr zam·mə·rū- lōw ‘ā·śō·wr bə·nê·ḇel
verses.literal: Praise the LORD with the harp make music to Him with ten strings . . .

verses.original: שִֽׁירוּ־ ל֭וֹ חָדָ֑שׁ שִׁ֣יר נַ֝גֵּ֗ן הֵיטִ֥יבוּ בִּתְרוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šî·rū- lōw ḥā·ḏāš šîr nag·gên hê·ṭî·ḇū biṯ·rū·‘āh
verses.literal: Sing to Him a new song play skillfully with a shout of joy

verses.original: כִּֽי־ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֑ה יָשָׁ֥ר וְכָל־ מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ בֶּאֱמוּנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- də·ḇar- Yah·weh yā·šār wə·ḵāl ma·‘ă·śê·hū be·’ĕ·mū·nāh
verses.literal: For the word of the LORD is upright and all His work is trustworthy

verses.original: אֹ֭הֵב צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט הָאָֽרֶץ׃ מָלְאָ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה חֶ֥סֶד
verses.transliteration: ’ō·hêḇ ṣə·ḏā·qāh ū·miš·pāṭ hā·’ā·reṣ mā·lə·’āh Yah·weh ḥe·seḏ
verses.literal: [The LORD] loves righteousness and justice the earth is full of [His] loving devotion

verses.original: בִּדְבַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה שָׁמַ֣יִם נַעֲשׂ֑וּ כָּל־ צְבָאָֽם׃ וּבְר֥וּחַ פִּ֝֗יו
verses.transliteration: biḏ·ḇar Yah·weh šā·ma·yim na·‘ă·śū kāl- ṣə·ḇā·’ām ū·ḇə·rū·aḥ pîw
verses.literal: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made and all the stars by the breath of His mouth

verses.original: כֹּנֵ֣ס כַּ֭נֵּד מֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם נֹתֵ֖ן תְּהוֹמֽוֹת׃ בְּאֹצָר֣וֹת
verses.transliteration: kō·nês kan·nêḏ mê hay·yām nō·ṯên tə·hō·w·mō·wṯ bə·’ō·ṣā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: He piles up . . . the waters of the sea He puts the depths into storehouses

verses.original: כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ יִֽירְא֣וּ מִמֶּ֥נּוּ מֵ֭יְהוָה כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל׃ יָ֝ג֗וּרוּ
verses.transliteration: kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ yî·rə·’ū mim·men·nū Yah·weh kāl- yō·šə·ḇê ṯê·ḇêl yā·ḡū·rū
verses.literal: Let all the earth fear . . . the LORD let all the people of the world revere Him

verses.original: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא אָמַ֣ר וַיֶּ֑הִי הֽוּא־ צִ֝וָּ֗ה וַֽיַּעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kî hū ’ā·mar way·ye·hî hū- ṣiw·wāh way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ
verses.literal: For He spoke and it came to be He commanded and it stood firm

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה הֵפִ֥יר עֲצַת־ גּוֹיִ֑ם הֵ֝נִ֗יא מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת עַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh hê·p̄îr ‘ă·ṣaṯ- gō·w·yim hê·nî maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ ‘am·mîm
verses.literal: The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations He thwarts the devices of the peoples

verses.original: עֲצַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה תַּעֲמֹ֑ד לְעוֹלָ֣ם מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת לִ֝בּ֗וֹ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ṣaṯ Yah·weh ta·‘ă·mōḏ lə·‘ō·w·lām maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ lib·bōw lə·ḏōr wā·ḏōr
verses.literal: The counsel of the LORD stands forever . . . the purposes of His heart to all generations . . .

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הַ֭גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר־ אֱלֹהָ֑יו יְהוָ֣ה הָעָ֓ם׀ בָּחַ֖ר לְנַחֲלָ֣ה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê hag·gō·w ’ă·šer- ’ĕ·lō·hāw Yah·weh hā·‘ām bā·ḥar lə·na·ḥă·lāh lōw
verses.literal: Blessed [is] the nation whose God is the LORD the people He has chosen as His inheritance

verses.original: יְהוָ֑ה הִבִּ֣יט מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם רָ֝אָ֗ה אֶֽת־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh hib·bîṭ miš·šā·ma·yim rā·’āh ’eṯ- kāl- bə·nê hā·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: The LORD looks down from heaven He sees - all the sons of men

verses.original: יֹשְׁבֵ֣י מִֽמְּכוֹן־ הִשְׁגִּ֑יחַ אֶ֖ל כָּל־ שִׁבְתּ֥וֹ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: yō·šə·ḇê mim·mə·ḵō·wn- hiš·gî·aḥ ’el kāl- šiḇ·tōw hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: From His dwelling place He gazes on all who inhabit the earth

verses.original: הַיֹּצֵ֣ר לִבָּ֑ם יַ֣חַד הַ֝מֵּבִ֗ין אֶל־ כָּל־ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yō·ṣêr lib·bām ya·ḥaḏ ham·mê·ḇîn ’el- kāl- ma·‘ă·śê·hem
verses.literal: He shapes the hearts of each He considers . . . all their works

verses.original: אֵֽין־ הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ נוֹשָׁ֣ע בְּרָב־ חָ֑יִל לֹֽא־ גִּ֝בּ֗וֹר יִנָּצֵ֥ל בְּרָב־ כֹּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ên- ham·me·leḵ nō·wō·šā‘ bə·rāḇ- ḥā·yil lō- gib·bō·wr yin·nā·ṣêl bə·rāḇ- kō·aḥ
verses.literal: No king is saved by his vast army no warrior is delivered by his great strength

verses.original: הַ֭סּוּס שֶׁ֣קֶר לִתְשׁוּעָ֑ה וּבְרֹ֥ב חֵ֝יל֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: has·sūs še·qer liṯ·šū·‘āh ū·ḇə·rōḇ ḥê·lōw lō yə·mal·lêṭ
verses.literal: A horse is a vain hope for salvation even its great strength cannot save

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה עֵ֣ין יְ֭הוָה אֶל־ יְרֵאָ֑יו לַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ‘ên Yah·weh ’el- yə·rê·’āw lam·ya·ḥă·lîm lə·ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him on those whose hope is in His loving devotion

verses.original: לְהַצִּ֣יל נַפְשָׁ֑ם מִמָּ֣וֶת וּ֝לְחַיּוֹתָ֗ם בָּרָעָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: lə·haṣ·ṣîl nap̄·šām mim·mā·weṯ ū·lə·ḥay·yō·w·ṯām bā·rā·‘āḇ
verses.literal: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine

verses.original: נַ֭פְשֵׁנוּ חִכְּתָ֣ה לַֽיהוָ֑ה הֽוּא׃ עֶזְרֵ֖נוּ וּמָגִנֵּ֣נוּ
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šê·nū ḥik·kə·ṯāh Yah·weh hū ‘ez·rê·nū ū·mā·ḡin·nê·nū
verses.literal: Our soul waits for the LORD He is our help and our shield

verses.original: כִּי־ לִבֵּ֑נוּ יִשְׂמַ֣ח ב֭וֹ כִּ֤י בָטָֽחְנוּ׃ קָדְשׁ֣וֹ בְשֵׁ֖ם
verses.transliteration: kî- lib·bê·nū yiś·maḥ ḇōw kî ḇā·ṭā·ḥə·nū qā·ḏə·šōw ḇə·šêm
verses.literal: For our hearts rejoice in Him since we trust in His holy name

verses.original: חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְהִֽי־ עָלֵ֑ינוּ יְהוָ֣ה כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר יִחַ֥לְנוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥas·də·ḵā yə·hî- ‘ā·lê·nū Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer yi·ḥal·nū lāḵ
verses.literal: May Your loving devotion rest on us O LORD as we put our hope in You
